description: Returns Global FinReg's LEI prices in every supported currency, excluding VAT: for a new registration and for a renewal, for 1, 3 and 5 years, each as pricePerYear and total for the whole period; and the optional fully assisted service. For the exact total for one LEI, including VAT, use get_registration_quote or get_renewal_quote.
name: get_prices
title: Get LEI prices
